zh: 修复工作区右侧边栏（工作区、外部会话卡及文件预览）无法手动调整宽度的问题：补全桌面端三列/两列布局中的 `--workspace-panel-width` 优先级回退、恢复窄屏抽屉高于遮罩层的层级、作用域限定旧版折叠状态规则，并将侧栏拖拽手柄纳入桌面端不可拖拽标题区域。
en: Fixed manual width resizing for right-hand workspace sidebars (Workspace, external session cards, and file preview): restored `--workspace-panel-width` in desktop grid rules, raised the narrow-screen drawer z-index above its backdrop, scoped legacy collapsed preview grid rules away from `platform-home`, and excluded resize handles from desktop titlebar drag regions.
